title: Seacrest Beach "30A Sandy Beachfront" 8220 E County Hwy 30A Unit B
h1: Seacrest Beach "30A Sandy Beachfront" 8220 E County Hwy 30A Unit B
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf Front- 180 Degree Gulf Views from Both Floors- Private Pool and Sitting Spa *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $50 per day* Pool chiller runs complimentary in July and August- Private Beach Walkover- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 4 beach chairs and 2 umbrellas (Service provided March 1 - October 31)- Sonos Sound System(indoor only)- 5 Adult bikes- 6-Seater Low-Speed Vehicle- Peloton bike- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Escape to the lavish Gulf-front beauty of 30A Sandy Beachfront, a grand 2-story haven with 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms that accommodates up to 17 in unparalleled comfort. Located in the coveted Seacrest Beach, this gem offers an idyllic escape to soft sandy beaches, laid-back eateries, and local shops. Fall in love with this home’s enchanted 180-degree Gulf views, private pool, and effortless beach access.Upon entering this sleek beach home, discover an exquisite and sunny interior of refined elegance. Impeccably polished Travertine tile floors stretch through the open-concept great room, where sliding glass doors showcase the endless sun-kissed views of the glistening Gulf. Entertaining guests is an effortless delight with the high-end Thermador appliances and outstanding waterfall island, which conveniently doubles as a breakfast bar for 4. After a sumptuous meal at the traditional 8-person dining table, loved ones can sink into the plush comfort of 2 sofas in the intimate living area with a 65" Smart TV and Sonos soundbar—the ultimate in-home entertainment. An arrangement of outdoor furniture sits opposite the natural gas grill and 8-seat alfresco dining table on the back patio, beckoning for an afternoon repose in the balmy breeze, listening to the soothing sound of the lapping Gulf waters. Beyond is a private pool with a complimentary cooling function available from July to August. Completing this floor is a guest bedroom with a king bed and Smart TV, as well as a versatile bunk room boasting 1 twin-over-twin bunk bed, 2 full-over-queen bunk beds, and a twin sleeper sofa.Upstairs hosts 2 lavish guest bedrooms, each outfitted with a Smart TV, regal king bed, and opulent private bathroom. Moreover, with its picturesque panorama of Gulf views, the delightful patio creates a peaceful haven.Steps away from beach access with gorgeous views of the Gulf, 30A Sandy Beachfront is the ultimate setting for an indulgent Seacrest Beach vacation. Leisurely explore the area with 5 complimentary adult bikes—plus a 6-person low speed vehicle—and take pleasure in having a private beach walkover that leads to a public beach off the back of the home. Book this blissful beach home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 17):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: One Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Two Full-over-Queen Bunk Beds, and a Twin Sleeper Sofa, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*Please note that Gulf-front bonfires are not permitted at this location per Walton County regulations.*The beach before 30A Sandy Beachfront is not privately owned.*Parking for 3 vehicles is feasible, but better suited for 3 compact vehicles
